summary: Dogness (International) Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of 3,050,000 Class A common shares upon cash exercise of outstanding warrants on August 13, 2026. Concurrently, the company amended its Share Acquisition Agreement, reducing the target equity interest in Dogness Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. from 19.5% to 6.735%, with transfer required by November 6, 2026. The amendment waived beneficial ownership limitations and the 61-day waiting period, imposing a nine-month lock-up on the issued shares. This reflects a bespoke financing and acquisition amendment, not a standard special-situation category.
